name: Bringing AI products to life
description: A 2-hour AI product boot camp that aims to cultivate a new generation of AI product leaders who can drive innovation in the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. This intensive & immersive bootcamp is designed to equip product managers with specialized AI skills & get them ready to create a startup or join a company as an AI PM.

name: 2043 - The impact of AI in 20 years
description: What will AI look like on a 10-20 year time horizon? Embark on a visionary journey to 2043, imagining the AI landscape two decades from now. From groundbreaking innovations to ethical dilemmas, explore the myriad of possibilities that await.

name: How AI is Transforming Urban Life and Advancing Mobility Solutions
description: Join sf.citi for a thought-provoking discussion on the transformative power of AI in urban contexts. Our panel of experts will explore how AI is revolutionizing urban mobility and governance, offering fresh perspectives on the future-proofing of our cities. Discover how AI-driven innovations shape urban life and pave the way for smarter, more efficient, and increasingly accessible urban environments.

name: Jerry Liu
title: Founder at LlamaIndex
bio: Jerry is the co-founder/CEO of LlamaIndex, a data framework for building LLM applications. Before this, he has spent his career at the intersection of ML, research, and startups. He led the ML monitoring team at Robust Intelligence, did self-driving AI research at Uber ATG, and worked on recommendation systems at Quora. He graduated from Princeton in 2017 with a degree in CS.

name: Will next generation LLM’s borrow insights from game research?
description: Explore how gamification principles can enhance LLM capabilities, fostering creativity, problem-solving, and natural language understanding. Delve into the potential of interactive and immersive game-based learning to empower LLMs. Examine the ethical considerations and challenges in implementing these approaches. Join us to envision the future of LLMs, where game research shapes cutting-edge language models for a wide range of applications.

name: Foundational Models Panel - Future Outlook
description: Dive deep into the evolving landscape of foundational models and their implications for the future. Understand the advancements, challenges, and potential breakthroughs that lie ahead including the race between open source and proprietary models.

name: LLM - stochastic parrot or spark of AGI?
description: Delve into the inner workings of LLM (Large Language Models) and their current trajectory. Are they mere "stochastic parrots" or do they show glimpses of AGI (Artificial General Intelligence)?
